name: Airbnb review alerts: low-star guest reviews → Slack + Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Airbnb review alerts: low-star guest reviews → Slack + Google Sheets
Every morning: fetch the newest Airbnb reviews for your listings, keep only new reviews of 3 stars or less, append them to a sheet and post each one to Slack — flagged *unanswered* until the host replies.

**Setup**
1. Credentials → **Header Auth** named `Apify Header Auth`: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer <your Apify token>` (apify.com → Settings → API & Integrations). Select it in *Run Airbnb reviews*.
2. Put your listing ids (the number in airbnb.com/rooms/…) in the JSON body of *Run Airbnb reviews* — or use `locationQueries` to watch a whole market.
3. Connect Slack and Google Sheets in the last two nodes. Sheet header row: name, rating, text, created_at, reviewer_name, reviewer_location, host_reply, reply_status, url, fetched_on.

Actor: https://apify.com/kestrel/airbnb-reviews-scraper — $0.005 per delivered review. Only reviews ≤ 3★ are delivered and billed: at most 50 × $0.005 = $0.25 per listing per day, usually zero to a few cents. Listing and status rows are free.
